title: Counter-top model Farberware Professional FMO13AHTBKF 1.3 Cubic Foot 1100-Watt Microwave Oven with Sensor Cooking, Matte Black
text:
Counter-top model Farberware Professional FMO13AHTBKF 1.3 Cubic Foot 1100-Watt Microwave Oven with Sensor Cooking, Matte Black. *** update 2018-August-24th: About a month ago: I’ve kept it immaculately clean and enjoyed using immensely. I can no longer keep it plugged in, and I have to watch it like a hawk any time I nuke anything. When the timer runs out, the machine keeps on humming - - - and it’s still cooking. today it ran about 90 second extra, just enough time to turn a frozen burrito that I’d only put in for 60 seconds into a charred lump of flaming scariness. Ooooo, the icky smell! I have to unplug it, too, because sometimes it just starts up of its own accord.

Counter-top model. This is a serious machine weighing 36 pounds outside the box. Bonus Child safety lock function. Comes with a terrifically useful user's manual.
Turntable is 12.4 inches
Width (in) 16.65
Height (in) 12.36
Length (in) 20.43
Made in China Distributed by Edge Consumer Brands New York via agreement with Farberware. You can find all the details you need not at the Farberware website but at 'farberwaremicrowaves' dot com. Except I could not find this exact model which is FMO13AHTBKF, I was able to find the model 'FMO13AHTBSE' which gave me the link to the user manual (also provided in the box) for this model:
FMO13AHTPLE - White Stainless steel $149
FMO13AHTBKF* - black plastic $149
FMO13AHTBSE - black stainless steel $179

1 year warranty appears to be via Edge and not Farberware.

I couldn't find a company website but found this tidbit on the internet about the company:

EDGE focus is on making it easy to do business together.

product_metadata.title: Farberware Professional FMO13AHTBKF 1.3 Cu. Ft. 1100-Watt Microwave Oven with Smart Sensor Cooking, ECO Mode and Blue LED Lighting, Matte Black
features: 1100 watts of cooking power and 10 power levels allow you to adjust the power from 10% to 100%; Multi-stage cooking for custom-cooked meals and snacks
1 to 3-minute instant start functions, Add 30 second control and 2 automatic defrost options
9 One-Touch cooking programs allow you to heat up everyday items in seconds
Smart Sensor cooking prepares preset menu items and reheats food with precision
Energy Saver power mode allows you to conserve energy when the microwave is not in active use
12.4 inch removable rotating glass turntable; Keypad Lock prevents unsupervised use
description: The Farberware Professional 1.3 Cubic Foot 1100 Watt Microwave Oven with Smart Sensor Cooking delivers power, style, and convenience with a sleek design to complement your kitchen. With a 12.4-inch turntable, this models roomy interior accommodates oversized dinner plates, perfect for a large family gathering. Smart Sensor cooking allows you to prepare preset menu items and reheat foods with precision and no guesswork. An Energy Saver power mode allows you to conserve energy when the microwave is not in active use. Amenities such as 1 to 3-minute instant start functions, +30-Seconds control button, 10 power control levels, 2 automatic defrost options, and Memory Function take the guesswork out of food prep. Its Multi-Stage cooking functionality adjusts cooking level mid-cycle allowing for the perfect finish. 9 One-Touch cooking programs allow for you to heat up everyday items in seconds. Additional features include a blue LED display with kitchen timer and clock as well as a child safety lock function to prevent accidental operation.
